scope: Main S2 access and raw-model-data protection slice; UI and full deployment acceptance remain separate

httpSmoke.transport: actual HTTP listener on loopback, persistent reads against isolated migrated PostgreSQL

behaviorChecks: Anonymous protected reads denied; health and session discovery remain reachable
Bearer parity, opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Strict sessions, expiry, forgery and server-side logout revocation
Foreign-origin writes rejected before mutation; logs exclude body/header/query/resource values
Raw non-fixture contracts need an exact explicitly authorized processing origin; loopback alone is insufficient
Synthetic exemption recomputes canonical content hash and rejects real external verification or prior-review evidence
Both keyed and keyless Pi requests reach the configured redirecting source but never send a payload to its redirect destination
limits: Shared-workspace access only; no per-person RBAC, SSO or multi-tenant isolation
Sessions are process-local and revoked on restart; single application instance remains required
Browser access shell and complete deployment/fault acceptance are not covered by this slice
